newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle very slow at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle very slow at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area early Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 500 slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 23,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 15,000 formulated and 400 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1075 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 950-1050 lbs 65.00.
